transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot make evidence-based decisions while flying blind; aggressive genomic and community surveillance is needed immediately to determine true severity and spread.

actions.rationale: We cannot make evidence-based decisions while flying blind; aggressive genomic and community surveillance is needed immediately to determine true severity and spread.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Hospital admissions are already rising, so we must pre-position ventilators, PPE, and testing supplies before any supply-chain crunch.

actions.rationale: Hospital admissions are already rising, so we must pre-position ventilators, PPE, and testing supplies before any supply-chain crunch.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: A crash public-private therapeutic and vaccine program takes months to years; starting now is the only path to a definitive biological solution.

actions.rationale: A crash public-private therapeutic and vaccine program takes months to years; starting now is the only path to a definitive biological solution.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Honest, daily data-driven communication will build public trust, reduce panic, and explain why we are preparing aggressively while awaiting better data.

actions.rationale: Honest, daily data-driven communication will build public trust, reduce panic, and explain why we are preparing aggressively while awaiting better data.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives governors, markets, and citizens the same real-time picture and prevents information vacuums.

actions.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives governors, markets, and citizens the same real-time picture and prevents information vacuums.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We need statutory authority and emergency funding lined up now so partisan delays do not slow the response once the picture clarifies.

actions.rationale: We need statutory authority and emergency funding lined up now so partisan delays do not slow the response once the picture clarifies.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: Regardless of the final severity, shielding the elderly and high-risk is the most cost-effective immediate step to save lives while keeping broader society open.

actions.rationale: Regardless of the final severity, shielding the elderly and high-risk is the most cost-effective immediate step to save lives while keeping broader society open.

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: With likely undetected spread and unknown transmissibility, a federal masking standard in jurisdictions we control is a low-cost way to slow transmission while we gather data.

actions.rationale: With likely undetected spread and unknown transmissibility, a federal masking standard in jurisdictions we control is a low-cost way to slow transmission while we gather data.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens.

transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.3 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 57/100. Hospital strain 5/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 32/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: The assessment still says data are too thin to pin down severity; we need an even broader surveillance and sequencing push to resolve whether this is a bad flu or catastrophic before committing to lockdowns.

actions.rationale: The assessment still says data are too thin to pin down severity; we need an even broader surveillance and sequencing push to resolve whether this is a bad flu or catastrophic before committing to lockdowns.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Hospital admissions are rising and R is above 1; we must stay ahead of the curve on ventilators, PPE, and test supplies before any supply crunch hits.

actions.rationale: Hospital admissions are rising and R is above 1; we must stay ahead of the curve on ventilators, PPE, and test supplies before any supply crunch hits.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: With R climbing to 1.3 and deaths still at zero, the public needs honest daily context on lag times, uncertainty, and why we are preparing aggressively without shutting down yet.

actions.rationale: With R climbing to 1.3 and deaths still at zero, the public needs honest daily context on lag times, uncertainty, and why we are preparing aggressively without shutting down yet.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We need emergency funding and statutory authority teed up now so we can move instantly on economic relief or broader measures the moment severity clarifies.

actions.rationale: We need emergency funding and statutory authority teed up now so we can move instantly on economic relief or broader measures the moment severity clarifies.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: With transmission rising, doubling down on nursing-home and high-risk protections is the highest-leverage step to prevent deaths while we await clearer severity data.

actions.rationale: With transmission rising, doubling down on nursing-home and high-risk protections is the highest-leverage step to prevent deaths while we await clearer severity data.

DEVELOPMENT: A cluster at a packed event seeds cases in a dozen new states. Pressure to act -- or to stop overreacting -- is intense from all sides.

SITUATION (Week 3). Estimated infection index 1.7 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 98/100. Public trust 59/100. Hospital strain 7/100. Restriction level 0.8/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 58/100.
ASSESSMENT (HIGH confidence): the pathogen is clearly worse than seasonal flu, with meaningful hospitalization; transmissibility is moderate.

actions.name: federal_lockdown_guidance

params.rationale: High confidence this pathogen is worse than flu, R=1.7 and rising, with hospital strain climbing; we must act before ICUs are overwhelmed.

actions.rationale: High confidence this pathogen is worse than flu, R=1.7 and rising, with hospital strain climbing; we must act before ICUs are overwhelmed.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Strong stay-at-home guidance will hit workers and small businesses immediately; emergency relief must accompany restrictions to prevent economic catastrophe.

actions.rationale: Strong stay-at-home guidance will hit workers and small businesses immediately; emergency relief must accompany restrictions to prevent economic catastrophe.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We need Congress to pass emergency relief and grant statutory authority so federal and state responses are funded and lawful.

actions.rationale: We need Congress to pass emergency relief and grant statutory authority so federal and state responses are funded and lawful.

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: Even as we lock down, expanded genomic and community surveillance is critical to locate hot spots and measure whether restrictions are bending the curve.

actions.rationale: Even as we lock down, expanded genomic and community surveillance is critical to locate hot spots and measure whether restrictions are bending the curve.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Hospital strain is rising and community spread is now multi-state; we must keep accelerating production of ventilators, PPE, and testing supplies.

actions.rationale: Hospital strain is rising and community spread is now multi-state; we must keep accelerating production of ventilators, PPE, and testing supplies.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: With confirmed spread in a dozen new states, we must harden protections in nursing homes and for high-risk populations to prevent the deaths we know lag behind cases.

actions.rationale: With confirmed spread in a dozen new states, we must harden protections in nursing homes and for high-risk populations to prevent the deaths we know lag behind cases.
